snippet.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Final Fantasy VII Revelation, the final entry in the FINAL FANTASY VII Remake Series, releases April 8, 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/final-fantasy-vii-revelation-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

In Final Fantasy VII Revelation, Cloud Strife and his loyal companions face a world that teeters on the brink of annihilation. Grieving a beloved ally, and with their nemesis Sephiroth nearing godhood, the party takes to the skies aboard the airship Highwind. Will they succeed in their race against time to stop Meteor, the ultimate destructive magic, and the total obliteration of the planet?

#NintendoDirect #FF7R #FinalFantasy

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
